lines.en: label day138:
scene premolly1
Another[school] day comes to a close as I sit in my office and try to figure out why this part of the job even exists.
lines.zh: 又一个[school]的日子接近尾声，我坐在自己的办公室里，试图想明白这岗位为什么还要存在。

lines.en: If the[school] is able to hire new janitors every time Ayane destroys one, how come they can’t hire a normal guidance counselor?
lines.zh: 既然每当 Ayane 弄坏一个清洁工，[school]都能再雇新的，那为什么他们就不能雇一个正经的心理咨询师？

lines.en: I’m entirely unqualified for this.
lines.zh: 我完全不够格。

lines.en: In fact, I’m entirely unqualified for virtually everything I do.
lines.zh: 事实上，我做的几乎每一件事都不够格。

lines.en: Has no one in the staff really figured that out by now?
lines.zh: 难道教职工里到现在真没人发现这一点吗？

lines.en: : Senseiiiiii~ Can I come in?
lines.zh: : Senseiiiiii~ 我能进来吗？

lines.en: Ami knocks on the door, probably to see if I can...love her or something. I don't know.
lines.zh: Ami 敲了敲门，大概是为了看看我能不能……爱她之类的。我不知道。

lines.en: It’s not often that she actually comes in here for counseling.
lines.zh: 她其实很少来这儿做咨询。

lines.en: In fact, she’s {i}never{/i} come in here for counseling, so I don’t really know what else it would be.
lines.zh: 事实上，她{i}从没{/i}来这儿做过咨询，所以我真不知道还会是因为什么。

lines.en: : Yeah, you can. Door’s open.
lines.zh: : 嗯，进来吧。门开着。

lines.en: scene premolly2
Ami enters the room and stops directly in front of my desk with a smirk on her face that says she's here for a little more than just {i}love.{/i}
lines.zh: Ami 走进房间，直接停在我的办公桌前，脸上挂着意味深长的坏笑，说明她来这儿可不只是为了{i}爱{/i}。

lines.en: : You want something, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 你是有所求吧？

lines.en: : Me? What gave you that idea?
lines.zh: : 我？你怎么会这么想？

lines.en: : Your face. You don’t smile like that unless you want something from me.
lines.zh: : 你那张脸。你只有在想从我这儿得到什么的时候才会那么笑。

lines.en: : That’s not true. I don’t want anything other than some quality time with my [uncle].
lines.zh: : 才不是。我什么都不要，只想和我[uncle]共度美好时光。

lines.en: : Are you coming on to me right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是在勾引我吗？

lines.en: if ami_virgin == False:
scene premolly3
: If I say yes, can we do it on your desk?
lines.zh: : 如果我说「是」，我们能在你的办公桌上做吗？

lines.en: : Sure.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: scene premolly4
: Wait, really?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？

lines.en: : I know you're not a great teacher, but I didn’t think you’d agree to something like that so easily.
lines.zh: : 我知道你不是什么好老师，但没想到你这么轻易就答应这种事。

lines.en: : That seems like a pretty horrible idea, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 这听起来是个相当糟糕的主意，Sensei。

lines.en: : It would be bad enough for you to get caught doing something like that in general...but I think it takes on a new level of ‘bad’ if it’s your [niece] that you’re, you know, doing stuff with.
lines.zh: : 一般来说，干这种事被抓就已经够糟了……但我觉得如果对象是你的[niece]，那可就是升级版的「糟」了，你懂的。

lines.en: : Sometimes, life is about taking risks, Ami. This is something you’ll come to learn with age.
lines.zh: : 有时候，人生就是要冒险，Ami。这是你长大后会明白的事。

lines.en: scene premolly5
: I’m sure I will. But that’s really not why I’m here today.
lines.zh: : 我肯定会明白的。不过我今天真不是为这个来的。

lines.en: : Then why {i}are{/i} you here today?
lines.zh: : 那你今天{i}来{/i}干什么？

lines.en: else:
scene premolly6
: Whaaaat? {i}Me{/i} coming on to my {i}[uncle]{/i}? As if something like that would ever happen.
lines.zh: : 什、什么？{i}我{/i}勾引我{i}[uncle]{/i}？这种事怎么可能发生。

lines.en: : Hahahahah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈……

lines.en: : Hahaha...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……

lines.en: scene premolly7
: Hah...
Well, it’s nice to see that Ami is just as bad at hiding things as ever.
lines.zh: 嗯，很高兴看到 Ami 藏不住事的老毛病一点没变。

lines.en: : If you’re not coming on to me...what is it then?
lines.zh: : 如果你不是在勾引我……那又是什么？

lines.en: : You normally just walk in and ask for whatever it is you want, so it seems a little weird that you’re not doing that today.
lines.zh: : 你平时都是直接走进来要你想要的东西，所以今天不这么做，看起来有点怪。

lines.en: scene premolly8
: Well, Sensei...I, Ami Arakawa, have come to your office on this fine day to inform you that I have heard a rumor circulating that may or may not involve you and our class.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Sensei……我，荒川 Ami，在这个美好的日子里来到你的办公室，是要通知你——我听到了一个传闻，可能和你和我们班有关，也可能无关。

lines.en: : I...do not like the sound of that.
lines.zh: : 我……不喜欢这话的开头。

lines.en: : Why? Have you been doing anything {i}naughty{/i} with any of them?
lines.zh: : 为什么？你该不会和她们中的谁干了什么{i}坏事{/i}吧？

lines.en: scene premolly9
: Wait, why are you staying quiet?! That was a joke!
lines.zh: : 等等，你为什么不说话？！那是个玩笑！

lines.en: if ami_virgin == False:
: You’re supposed to be like “Of course not! I would never do something like that with anyone but you, Ami!”
lines.zh: : 你应该说「当然没有！除了你，Ami，我绝不会和别人做那种事！」

lines.en: else:
: You’re supposed to be like “Of course not! I would never do something like that with a student!”
lines.zh: : 你应该说「当然没有！我绝不会和学生做那种事！」

lines.en: : Of course I wouldn’t do anything like that.
lines.zh: : 我当然不会做那种事。

lines.en: ...and admit to it.
lines.zh: ……然后承认。

lines.en: scene premolly10
: I don’t like the tone of your voice, Sensei...But I’m going to ignore it because I’m such a great [niece] and want to tell you about the thing I heard.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢你的语气，Sensei……不过我要忽略它，因为我是个超棒的[niece]，还想把我听到的事告诉你。

lines.en: Well...at least it seems like whatever this rumor is doesn’t involve anything that could get me fired- which is great news.
lines.zh: 嗯……至少看起来这传闻不涉及任何能让我被开除的事——这可是好消息。

lines.en: It would be one thing to lose my job over something like that, but I’m actually a little more terrified of what Ami would do to me if she ever found out.
lines.zh: 因为这种事丢工作是一回事，但我其实更怕的是，如果 Ami 发现了会怎么对我。

lines.en: : Okay, Ami...What is it you heard?
lines.zh: : 好了，Ami……你听到了什么？

lines.en: scene premolly8
: Oh, right.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。

lines.en: : I have heard that-
lines.zh: : 我听到说——

lines.en: scene premolly11
: Sensei? Are you in there right now?
lines.zh: : Sensei？你现在在里面吗？

lines.en: : Good. I’m coming in. Pardon the intrusion.
lines.zh: : 很好。我进来了。打扰了。

lines.en: scene premolly12
: Oh, hello Ami. I didn’t realize you were in here as well.
lines.zh: : 哦，你好，Ami。我不知道你也在这儿。

lines.en: : I just wanted to stop by to discuss the details of the upcoming transfer students.
lines.zh: : 我只是想过来讨论一下即将到来的转校生的细节。

lines.en: scene premolly13
: AAAAAAAH!!! THAT’S WHAT I WAS HERE TO TALK ABOUT!! YOU STOLE MY BIG REVEAL!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！！！我就是要来说这个的！！你抢走了我的大爆料！

lines.en: : I’m sorry...what transfer students?
lines.zh: : 抱歉……什么转校生？

lines.en: : Why would {i}you{/i} come here to discuss that? Official classroom business is my territory. I don’t understand how you’d be involved.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}为什么会来讨论这个？正式的班级事务是我的地盘。我不明白你为什么要掺和。

lines.en: : I’m involved because Sensei is my [uncle] and I love him!
lines.zh: : 我掺和是因为 Sensei 是我[uncle]，而我爱他！

lines.en: : That doesn’t have anything to do with[school] whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 这和[school]一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : Sure it does! I go to[school] and so does Sensei!
lines.zh: : 当然有！我在[school]上学，Sensei 也在[school]！

lines.en: : Is anyone going to tell me what’s going on here or do I just need to figure it out on my own?
lines.zh: : 有没有人能告诉我到底怎么回事，还是说我只能自己搞清楚？

lines.en: scene premolly14
: New girls! Class! Soon!
lines.zh: : 新女生！插班！很快！

lines.en: : Makoto. Please translate.
lines.zh: : Makoto。请翻译一下。

lines.en: : It’s more or less as Ami said.
lines.zh: : 大体上和 Ami 说的差不多。

lines.en: : It seems that the principal caught on to the fact that our class has significantly less students than most of the others, and so two girls will soon be transferring in.
lines.zh: : 校长似乎注意到我们班的人数明显比其他班少，所以很快会有两个女孩转进来。

lines.en: : Oh. So they’re not like, technically {i}transfer students.{/i} They’re just switching classes.
lines.zh: : 哦。所以严格来说她们不算{i}转校生{/i}，只是换个班。

lines.en: : Sure. If that makes it easier for you to understand.
lines.zh: : 对。如果这样更好理解的话。

lines.en: Lame.
lines.zh: 没劲。

lines.en: : Do you have any questions regarding the process?
lines.zh: : 关于流程你有什么问题吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Are they cute?
lines.zh: : 她们可爱吗？

lines.en: scene premolly15
: Aww. You two look like twins now.
lines.zh: : 哇哦。你们俩现在看起来像双胞胎了。

lines.en: I can’t help but feel like I asked the wrong question.
lines.zh: 我忍不住觉得我问错了问题。

lines.en: But in all fairness, what else was I supposed to ask there?
lines.zh: 不过说句公道话，我还能问什么呢？

lines.en: I just got straight to the point and I should be respected as a man for that. I don’t need to beat around the bush.
lines.zh: 我只是直奔主题，作为一个男人，我该因此受到尊重。我不需要拐弯抹角。

lines.en: : Is that...really the only question you have?
lines.zh: : 这……真的就是你唯一的问题吗？

lines.en: : Yes, Sensei. Is that {i}really{/i} the only question you have? Especially with an adorable girl already standing right in front of you?
lines.zh: : 对啊，Sensei。这{i}真的{/i}就是你唯一的问题吗？尤其是一个可爱的女孩已经站在你面前的时候？

lines.en: : Thank you, Ami. I didn’t realize you looked at me that way.
lines.zh: : 谢谢，Ami。我不知道你是这么看我的。

lines.en: scene premolly16
: I don’t. I think you’re ugly and stupid. I was talking about me.
lines.zh: : 我可没有。我觉得你又丑又蠢。我说的是我自己。

lines.en: : Oh, I see. You’re trying to get your [uncle] to notice how attractive you think you are. That is not at all abnormal.
lines.zh: : 哦，我明白了。你是想让你[uncle]注意到你觉得你自己多有魅力。这一点都不反常。

lines.en: : It would make much more sense for Sensei to be attracted to someone he isn’t related to. And since I am the only other girl in this room, that would have to be me.
lines.zh: : Sensei 被一个和他没有血缘关系的人吸引，才更说得通。而既然这房间里除了我就没别的女孩了，那就只能是我了。

lines.en: : Oh, please. The only person who would ever be attracted to you is like...a...weird person...or something.
lines.zh: : 哦，得了吧。会对你有感觉的人大概只有……某个……怪人……之类的。

lines.en: : Is that really all you can come up with?
lines.zh: : 你就只能想出这个？

lines.en: : Shut up. I’m cute and you’re gross.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。我可爱，而你恶心。

lines.en: : If you two wouldn’t mind, I’d really like to hear more about this transfer situation now.
lines.zh: : 如果你们俩不介意的话，我现在真的很想多听听转班这件事。

lines.en: : I can’t help but feel like it’s something I should be at least slightly prepared for.
lines.zh: : 我总觉得这件事我至少该稍微准备一下。

lines.en: scene premolly18
: Right. Apologies, Sensei. Let me get back to the matter at hand.
lines.zh: : 好的。抱歉，Sensei。让我回到正题。

lines.en: : {i}My name’s Makoto. I’m a grown woman trapped in a [teenage]girl’s body. My eyesight is bad. Blah blah blah.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我叫 Makoto。我是个被困在[teenage]女孩身体里的成年女性。我视力不好。巴拉巴拉。{/i}

lines.en: : Ami. Stop.
lines.zh: : Ami。别闹。

lines.en: : Hmph...
: I wish I had more details to share with you, but all I really know right now is that two girls are going to be transferring over from Ms. Watabe’s class in the near future.
lines.zh: : 我希望我能告诉你更多细节，但我现在真正知道的只有，近期会有两个女孩从 Watabe 老师的班上转过来。

lines.en: : Ms. Watabe is a bit...closed-off. So she was only willing to discuss {i}some{/i} of the situation with me.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师有点……封闭。所以她只愿意和我谈{i}一部分{/i}情况。

lines.en: : Regardless, I think we can expect at least one of them in the next few days. I just haven't been notified of which one yet.
lines.zh: : 不管怎样，我想我们在这几天内至少能迎来其中一个。只是还没人通知我是哪一个。

lines.en: scene premolly19
: Wait, is it really Ms. Watabe’s class that the girls are transferring from? I heard it was a different teacher.
lines.zh: : 等等，那两个女孩真的是从 Watabe 老师的班上转过来的吗？我听说是另一个老师。

lines.en: : I’m not quite sure {i}where{/i} you would have heard anything. My information came directly from the principal.
lines.zh: : 我不太清楚你从{i}哪儿{/i}听来的。我的信息直接来自校长。

lines.en: : Oh, sorry. I forgot you spend too much time studying to know what ‘rumors’ are.
lines.zh: : 哦，抱歉。我忘了你把太多时间花在学习上，不知道「传闻」是什么。

lines.en: scene premolly20
: O-Of course I know what rumors are! Forgive me for caring more about my education than my social circle!
lines.zh: : 我、我当然知道传闻是什么！原谅我更关心自己的学业而不是社交圈！

lines.en: : So basically, I’m going to get two random girls just thrown into my class in the middle of the[school] year and I can’t do anything about it?
lines.zh: : 所以基本上，我会在[school]学年中途被随便塞两个女孩进班里，而我什么都做不了？

lines.en: scene premolly21
: In layman’s terms, yes.
lines.zh: : 用通俗的话说，是的。

lines.en: : Are they aware of my...teaching methods?
lines.zh: : 她们知道我的……教学方式吗？

lines.en: : Your original ones or your current ones?
lines.zh: : 你原来那套，还是现在这套？

lines.en: : Current ones.
lines.zh: : 现在这套。

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 完全不知道。

lines.en: : They are in for a rude awakening if they are actually trying to learn.
lines.zh: : 如果她们真打算学点东西，那可有得受了。

lines.en: : But on the bright side, if they’re normal girls who don’t care about that sort of thing, you’ll be a-okay.
lines.zh: : 不过往好处想，如果她们是不在乎那种事的普通女孩，你就完全没事。

lines.en: : I like to believe that normal girls at least slightly care about their futures, so I don’t know if I’d count on that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我愿意相信普通女孩至少会稍微关心一下自己的未来，所以我可不指望这个，Sensei。

lines.en: Unfortunately for Makoto, I think I’d much prefer Ami’s type rather than hers in the class.
lines.zh: 对 Makoto 来说不幸的是，我更希望班上来的是 Ami 那种类型，而不是她那种。

lines.en: That’s not to say I don’t like Makoto. In fact, I think it’s pretty obvious that I like her a lot.
lines.zh: 这不是说我不喜欢 Makoto。事实上，很明显我很喜欢她。

lines.en: But more than one of her would just be way too much for me. I can barely keep up with her wealth of knowledge as-is.
lines.zh: 但再来一个她那样的，我可吃不消。光是跟上她一个人那海量的知识就已经够呛了。

lines.en: : Well, I guess we’ll just have to see what happens then, right?
lines.zh: : 嗯，那我们就等着看会发生什么吧，对吧？

lines.en: : Correct. I’ll handle most of the legwork for you, so all you really need to do is just have them introduce themselves once they transfer in.
lines.zh: : 没错。大部分跑腿的事我会帮你处理，所以你真正需要做的就是等她们转进来时让她们做个自我介绍。

lines.en: : Really? Does the staff really trust you enough to handle that sort of thing instead of me?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？校方真的信任你到让你来处理这种事，而不是我？

lines.en: scene premolly22
: Of course. If anything, I’d even say they trust me {i}more{/i} than you.
lines.zh: : 当然。要说的话，我甚至觉得他们信任我{i}胜过{/i}信任你。

lines.en: : Yeah...that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 是啊……有道理。

lines.en: Guess I can’t really blame them for that.
lines.zh: 这倒也不能怪他们。

lines.en: : Exactly. So, I suppose you can just keep doing what you always do and just deal with things as they come up.
lines.zh: : 没错。那么，我想你只要继续做你一直在做的事，遇到什么再处理什么就行了。

lines.en: : And in the meantime, I’ll see if there are any strings I can pull to get you one of the cuter girls.
lines.zh: : 同时，我会看看能不能动用一些人脉，给你争取一个更可爱的女孩。

lines.en: scene premolly24
: Wait a minute! Whose side are you even on?!
lines.zh: : 等一下！你到底站哪边的？！

lines.en: : The side that makes him happy.
lines.zh: : 让他开心的那一边。

lines.en: : I figured you’d be on that side too, Ami. Given how much you claim to care about him and all.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你也该站那边，Ami。毕竟你口口声声说自己有多在乎他。

lines.en: scene premolly25
: You...did NOT just say what I think you said, did you?...
lines.zh: : 你……该不会真的说了我以为你说的话吧？……

lines.en: : And with that, I shall take my leave. It’s been nice talking with you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那么，我就此告辞。和你聊天很愉快，Sensei。

lines.en: scene premolly26
Makoto suddenly vanishes from the office, leaving Ami in a fit of rage that she is unable to cope with.
lines.zh: Makoto 突然从办公室消失，留下 Ami 一团无处发泄的怒火。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: : I’ll be right back...
lines.zh: : 我马上回来……

lines.en: : I need to go commit a felony...
lines.zh: : 我得去犯个重罪……

lines.en: scene premolly1
And then Ami disappears as well.
lines.zh: 然后 Ami 也消失了。

lines.en: That’s interesting, though.
lines.zh: 不过这挺有意思的。

lines.en: Two new students out of virtually nowhere.
lines.zh: 凭空冒出两个新学生。

lines.en: I feel like the normal reaction for someone in my shoes would be something along the lines of, “Oh no. Extra work.”
lines.zh: 我觉得处在我这个位置的人，正常反应大概是「哦不。又多活儿。」

lines.en: But, being a man of culture and little-to-no-ethics...
lines.zh: 但作为一个有文化、又几乎没什么道德底线的人……

lines.en: I’m still just hoping they’re cute.
lines.zh: 我还是只希望她们可爱。

lines.en: scene black
$ day138 = True
$ ticktock = True
